notes.title: Update 15
notes.content:
- ADS FOV changes smoothed out for more polished feel.
- Enabled Early Z pass on masked and opaque meshes.

notes.title: Update 14
notes.content:
- hitting escape while in settings no longer keeps settings on the screen while allowiong player input.
- View distance bugs fixed on singleplayer and open world modes.
- Various performance fixes
- main menu looks a little cooler now

notes.title: Update 13
notes.content:
- Added Particle effects for high movement speeds
- Added UI indicators for wall jumps and vaulting
- Added new hitmarker effect where crosshair turns red on hit.
- Time slow now desaturates color on screen
- Walking animations made more satisfying and realistic
- Altered location of left hand in vault animation
- Tweaked Semi-Auto pistol recoil parameters for more stiff recoil

- Buffed accuracy of pump shotgun
- Increased Pump shotgun recoil

- Fixed location of "+1" UI marker when collecting goo

notes.title: Update 10!
notes.content:
- Removed graphical stuff in last updates, optimized them, added em back in, now with minimal performance impact.

- Recoil/Firing/Muzzle Flash/Casing Ejection animation system completely redesigned for smoother, more performant and less frame-jumpy animations

- Significantly buffed the semi auto pistol

- Probably a bunch of other stuff I forgot

- some settings sliders refuse to save for some reason I haven't figured out.

notes.title: Update 9
notes.content:
- Added Camera (Weapon)
- Added FOV Setting
- Added Resolution Scaling Setting (Band-Aid)

notes.title: Update 8
notes.content:
- fixed jump land animation
- Added semi pistol
- Added auto pistol

notes.title: Update 7
notes.content:
- Fixed unstable physics simulation under certain conditions:
   - Low FPS (0-45)
   - High FPS (120-2000)
   - Weapons with a large amount of recoil
- Added weapon sway while sitting still for more dynamic feel.
- Slides no longer automatically cancel upon the end of the slide. (Allows more control over your character to better navigate obstacles)
- Added show FPS option
- Added VSync option

notes.title: Update 6
notes.content:
Update 6
- Added Walking Sway
- Added Level 5 (half-baked)
- Added Bolt Action Rifle
- Added Tactical Bolt Action Rifle
- Added new song "heist".
- Added ADS FOV zoom effect.
- Added Sensitivity option.
- Added Custom crosshair for throwables
- Shop now darkens background when opening to improve contrast.
- Buncha other stuff



- Fixed sprinting while standing still, still creates the sprint effect/sound.
- Fixed Broken Crosshair on throwables
- Fixed awkward arm position for Grenade.
- Buncha other stuff.

notes.title: Update 5 Bugfix
notes.content:
Too many changes, broke saves.
- To fix, go to settings and hit "DEBUG RESET" which will reset the saves.

notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
Added:
- 3 new songs

Weapons Added:
- Fire Axe
- Battle Axe
- Grenade
- Impact Grenade

Fixes:
- Equipped Items' icons no longer clip outside of their border in the HUD.

Misc:
- Minor restructuring of the items' code base to make new content iterations more unique, easier, and faster to make.
- Minor performance optimizations.

notes.title: Update 4 Repair
notes.content: Fixed Issue Causing update 4 changes not to be seen

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
- Added option to hit (Space) to skip death screen for less downtime between runs.
- Fixed bug causing game to be bricked and fore restart when completing the last level available.
- Added Placeholder Music

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
Moved Time Slow Keybind to "R" key.
 Rounded the top corners of the half-wall jump obstacles to make them easier.
